# Voice samples: FluidR3_GM "Voice Oohs"

Credit line (shown in Settings): Voice samples: FluidR3_GM (Frank Wen), via midi-js-soundfonts.

- **Sound font:** FluidR3_GM by Frank Wen, built from his own recordings and public-domain
  samples. Upstream licence: MIT ("I hereby release Fluid under the MIT license";
  Debian copyright file: https://metadata.ftp-master.debian.org/changelogs//main/f/fluid-soundfont/fluid-soundfont_3.1-5.3_copyright).
- **Per-note MP3 renders:** https://github.com/gleitz/midi-js-soundfonts (the mirror lists
  FluidR3_GM under CC BY 3.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/). We follow both: this
  file and the Settings line give the credit.
- **What we changed:** converted with macOS afconvert to 16-bit mono 22050 Hz WAV, cut to
  1.5 s from the onset, peak scaled to 0.9, 60 ms fade-out, retuned by the cents below as read by js/pitch.js (tools/build-samples.mjs,
  run 2026-10-15).
